title: Prefix stability of the coin run
statement: Let $p$ be an infinite sequence of bits. Given a finite bit string, the coin-run procedure compares it in order with the corresponding initial bits of $p$, returning the bit of $p$ at the first position where they differ, and returning no value if there is no such position. This procedure is prefix-stable: any extension of a string on which it returns a bit returns that same bit.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an infinite sequence of bits
